
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/uoky/p/19718540" title="发布于 2026-03-14 19:12">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Termux 安装 OpenClaw 并配置飞书（PS：图太多了，贴不过来）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><strong>背景</strong>：已知Openclaw的安全隐患实在是太严重了，所以我选择使用Android系统，在Termux中进行安装</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><strong>写在前面</strong>：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">1. 本来是想正儿八经弄个教程的，但是要贴的图实在是太多太多了。所以只贴了一半的图，后面的图也差不多，就不贴了。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">2. 这个openclaw，因为安装在Termux上，跟<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>默认的常驻模式</strong></span>（电脑上）<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>不一样</strong></span>，是只能<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>手动启动</strong></span>，<strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">手动停止</span></strong>，</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">3. 为了避免在我不知情的情况下消耗token，我也<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>没有设定进程一直运行</strong></span>（其实是可以做的，但是麻烦，而且没有必要，它只需要在我需要时todo即可）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">4. 运行效果是，我启动，则可以用，我关闭，则不能用。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">5. 为什么有这么多安全隐患，还是安装了openclaw？</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">这个就涉及到Android系统本身的安全权限管控，包括你的手机没有root/连数据线的情况下，是不能获取sudo之类的权限的。我个人还是比较信任Android系统的安全管理，而且openclaw又在termux中，一些东西它完全安装不了，so，越狱是不太可能了（PS：可能会有人说docker也安全啊，其实docker也有容器逃逸的风险，我就不弄了，主要是用手机安装，我想放在哪里，就放在哪里，便携，而且安全性，相对来讲我已经可以接受了）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">目前这个环境来讲，已经受控很多了，但不清楚以后会不会有更多的技能投毒之类的，目前还是可以的。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">有人可能不了解Termux（自行了解吧），软件的安装步骤：<a style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/uoky/p/18944220">Termux 安装 - 人间春风意 - 博客园</a></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">1. 因为这个是旧手机，Termux里的环境毕竟旧了，所以先执行</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">pkg update &amp;&amp; pkg upgrade
</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;作用是：更新本地的软件包列表 &amp; 将系统中已安装的所有可升级软件包升级到最新版本</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314153718940-346619216.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;安装pnpm</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">npm install -g pnpm
</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314153847956-1458276099.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;初始化 pnpm 环境的命令</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"> pnpm setup
</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314153929737-2048730048.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;使配置环境生效（毕竟，terminal中修改环境变量后，需要全关再开，才生效，这个命令就是让其立刻生效）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314153950106-1287371744.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;安装git</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">pkg install git
</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314154118392-514167327.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;安装openclaw</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">pnpm add -g openclaw@latest
</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314153542291-1977226281.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;下面这个命令可以执行，也可以不执行（因为这个命令一直执行下去，<strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">会配置环境需要的一些参数</span></strong>，但最后会<strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">报错</span></strong>，提示Gateway service install not supported on android</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">但是，不支持是原因是因为它所需要的后台一直运行的一些命令它不支持，So，这也是我觉得使用这个环境更安全受控一点的原因）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">报错<strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">最后忽略</span></strong>就行，因为后面可以<strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">直接执行open onboard</span></strong>，在推荐选择安装gateway时，选择No，不安装gateway，然后直接使用openclaw gateway --port 10101（端口自定义，随便）就可以启动，飞书也可以正常发送接受消息。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314154503081-1229387315.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;这个是危险声明，但危险在所难免，选择Yes（Termux 在 Android 系统中运行在应用沙盒中，默认情况下无法访问其他应用的数据，So，一些软件，想卸载就卸载，不想卸载就不卸载。建议卸载，谨防权限越狱）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">（这个Yes要用Termux的&lt;-按钮选中）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314154840249-1856283257.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;选择快速启动（也可以选择Manual）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314155254787-319236044.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;确认自己要使用的模型，以及配置认证信息，（已知默认里面的Qwen配置是网页登录认证，但termux是纯命令行，所以建议选择Custom Provider，自行配置模型地址，以及APIKey，也可以先跳过，后面再使用 openclaw config的命令修改model的配置使用在最后有贴图qwen是怎么获取key的）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314155452467-203675751.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314160400103-877345446.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;选择暂时跳过</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314160733748-324845018.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;这个选择All providers</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314161518203-1115348750.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;设定默认调用的模型，可以访问外网的，就默认，不可以的就自行设定，或者选择下列的模型，All is ok .</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314161655617-1735992510.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;国内就自行设定默认模型了</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314161756059-1171196737.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;软件选的飞书（PS：没有选择微信，是因为怕账号被封，毕竟微信里加的都是真人）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314161950680-891351932.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;本来选择直接下载最新的，但是报错了，没空看，就直接用local的了。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314162213598-2065474777.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;使用飞书，文章的最后面，有配置飞书需要配置的内容，这里就假设你已经配好了，拿到了keyid，key sceret，以及机器人可以使用的群聊id</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314162322846-1602068212.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;选择输入App密钥，并复制飞书页面（最下面飞书相关的图）中的AppSecret</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314162913311-905480423.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314163519553-1212858317.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314163633206-241290076.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;飞书的连接模式，选择默认的即可</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314163716671-1487428361.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;地域选择中国</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314163743516-1514531148.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;聊天的策略，也选择默认（后面再配置群组）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314163843192-1624213379.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">配置chat_id（拿chat_id的方式，在最下面）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314164037410-628920841.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">搜索引擎</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314170918540-1334037616.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;选择搜索引擎提供商，默认即可（这个国内网默认不通），然后key设定跳过，这个搜索API有免费额度，但超过后会收费，就直接跳过，不用了，</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314171107372-850873647.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;技能就先不配置了</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314171643908-957351340.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314171701765-869353605.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;hook先跳过</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314171735285-874496913.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314171847304-177090996.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">然后到最后一步，安装gateway的时候，报错不支持android。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314172019067-1018285529.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;然后继续使用即可（但是没有这个，也是可以继续用gateway，但跟这个安装的gateway又不一样，不会系统常驻）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><span>其中如果设定qwen 的 apikey又麻烦一点，需要openclaw config，选择model，依次配置模型所需的值。</span></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><span>说一下遇到的问题：</span></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><span>1. 还没有设定模型的key ，先运行的openclaw，然后查看日志，我这边在飞书发消息，openclaw的日志是已经可以收到回调日志了。</span></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><span>2. 设定qwen key详细方式我就不说了，网上一堆，方式多种多样，但建议不要直接修改json文件，太麻烦，就使用简单的openclaw的config命令，或者再快速走一遍onboard也行，设定模型时，选择自定义供应商即可，这个一定要配正确</span></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><span>3. 配飞书，同一个群聊，发消息，要@机器人才行，不然不会回复（这个应该是跟我设定的机器人的权限有关。）</span></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><span>4. @机器人后，机器人会快速回复一个表情，然后自动撤回，这个问题，就写博客这一会儿时间就忘记了，感觉脑子不行，检查飞书的事件回调配置即可</span></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">模型相关：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">国内我暂时选择Qwen</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><a href="https://www.aliyun.com/product/bailian" rel="noopener nofollow">大模型服务平台百炼 - 大模型应用构建 - 阿里云</a></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314160102132-1198417944.png" alt="image" width="999" height="700" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314160152720-553700417.png" alt="image" width="998" height="804" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;飞书相关：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">先登录&nbsp;<a href="https://open.feishu.cn/" rel="noopener nofollow">飞书开放平台</a></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314162510569-2019504013.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;<a href="https://open.feishu.cn/app" rel="noopener nofollow">开发者后台 - 飞书开放平台</a></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314162657905-1552026176.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314162735995-462682627.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314162832778-1139058471.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314163419446-148118409.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314165239584-83210122.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">这个事件回调，我需要额外说明一下，是需要先启动飞书client端成功后，才能配置长连接回调，所以我是先没有配模型key，启动的openclaw，然后client端启动后，这里再配置长连接才行，（PS：我看其它博客都没有介绍过这一点，不知道是不是我这个环境太特别导致的，还是什么。）</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314164837594-373958317.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314190034946-2004885170.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314190200487-526713785.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">创建一个群聊，把这个bot加进来（这个需要自己在手机APP里建立一个群聊，把机器人加进来）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">再访问&nbsp;&nbsp;<a href="https://open.feishu.cn/document/server-docs/group/chat/list?appId=cli_a93fa01849b8dbc6" rel="noopener nofollow">获取用户或机器人所在的群列表 - 服务端 API - 开发文档 - 飞书开放平台</a>&nbsp;获取chat_id，也就是群聊id</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314170429575-40201108.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<div><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;最后show一下正常启动的日志（PS：我前面有说过一些权限受限，所以，你如果通过这种方式配置，注意有一些命令，或者找/bin的目录不能正常执行）</span></div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260314191140800-1329538671.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
